title: Carry a review discussion to resolution
statement: As a developer reviewing a change, I can reply to, resolve, and reopen an anchored discussion so its outcome and full context remain visible.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A reply appears in the same thread and retains the root comment’s slide-or-item context.
A later thread action can resolve or reopen the thread, and the review’s open-thread count reflects the latest explicit state.
Resolving or reopening a thread leaves its earlier comments visible in order.
